svg.title: Ommatix protocol demo: observe, an action on a stale snapshot refused, observe again, act
svg.desc: On a simulated desktop, only the changed tiles are analysed; the controls get identifiers and revisions (e7 revision 3, e8 revision 1). The agent calls observe_screen and execute_action. A dry-run action on snapshot s16, older than the 10-second limit, is rejected with STALE_SNAPSHOT and no input. A new observation publishes s17, and the dry-run action on it returns simulated with input_delivered false.
svg.text: Simulated desktop · illustration, not a screen recording

g.text: Only the regions that changed are analysed again.
Each control gets a session ID and a revision.
The agent reads elements: no pixels, no coordinates.
An action on an expired snapshot is refused. No input is sent.
Observe again, then act: the dry run reports what happened.
The agent acts by ID and revision; an action on a stale snapshot is refused.
